source_of_truth_precedence: Active Governance Kernel (Sentinel capability baseline, currently v1.4.0)
precedence_statement: This manifest is descriptive foundation metadata introduced by S2 (ML-DEVOS-RFC-001, ML-DEVOS-AS-006, D-016). It is strictly subordinate to the frozen architecture, the active governance-capability baseline, brain/DECISION_LOG.md decisions, ADRs, and durable Architect Syncs. It may summarize or reference those records; it may never redefine, weaken, or override them. The project registry index is in turn subordinate to this manifest -- the registry may record project facts, never governance authority.
reserved_root_invariant: A reserved subsystem root's existence means only that it is the canonical future home for its owning phase's artifacts. It does not mean that phase's subsystem is implemented. No reserved root may contain executable implementation of its owning (or any later) phase until that phase is itself separately proposed, reviewed, and authorized. Later phases may consume artifacts from a root but may not redefine its ownership without a separately governed ARCHITECTURE-class change. This invariant did not lapse when S2 closed -- it remains standing until each specific phase's own authorization.

project_registry.note: Points to project-owned authoritative overlays; does not duplicate project memory/task state/evidence/requirements/risks/local governance. No project has been onboarded as of S2 closure. A future entry requires the active PROJECT_ONBOARDING process and explicit Paulo authorization -- S2 closure does not itself authorize or imply one.

legacy_bootstrap_surfaces.note: Bootstrap/legacy governance surface predating Sentinel; remains active until a separately authorized migration/retirement decision.
Bootstrap turn-lock and handoff surface; remains active until a separately authorized migration/retirement decision. Not superseded by this manifest.

prohibition: No reserved subsystem root, and no artifact created by this manifest's own S2 foundation, may be treated as an implemented runtime subsystem. Creation of a directory, README, or schema is not authorization to implement the subsystem it is reserved for. Only a separately governed change for that specific phase (its own RFC, Architect Sync, and Paulo decision) may introduce executable behavior there.

closure_history.note: S2 DevOS Repository Foundation adopted into the active Sentinel baseline; v1.3.0 -> v1.4.0 MINOR transition applied. First entry recorded in this manifest -- S1's earlier closure (v1.2.0 -> v1.3.0) predates this manifest's own existence (the manifest is itself an S2 deliverable) and is recorded instead in brain/DECISION_LOG.md D-013 and devos/changes/adrs/ML-DEVOS-ADR-001.md.
